errors.text: The proposed severe-plastic-deformation route does not reconstruct the target static HPHT treatment in a hexahedron-anvil apparatus.
The proposed 600–800 °C window is substantially below the target 1473 K treatment, and the required two-hour hold is omitted.

The mechanism predicts interface fragmentation and reduced coherence length, whereas the target mechanism depends on formation of coherent FCC/B2 interfaces and preferential dislocation transfer between phases.
The HIP control changes both pressure and deformation mode, so it cannot cleanly isolate the effect of extreme hydrostatic pressure.
The cited evidence concerns different alloy compositions and processing routes and does not substantiate the claimed pressure-temperature window or microstructural transformation.
